sites.description: AI-native documentation platform. Agents can search and read Mintlify docs, get a site outline and read its agent skills.

invoke.example: tools/call search_mintlify {"query": "..."} -> cited passages; query_docs_filesystem_mintlify head -80 /<path>.mdx

sites.skill:
ASK mintlify.com docs (platform: mintlify).
TIER 1 — headless-safe (MCP, no auth): POST https://www.mintlify.com/docs/mcp JSON-RPC (Streamable HTTP, Accept: application/json, text/event-stream).
init: {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"x","version":"0"}}}
search: tools/call {"name":"search_mintlify","arguments":{"query":"..."}} -> results with page paths.
read: tools/call {"name":"query_docs_filesystem_mintlify","arguments":{"command":"head -80 /<path>.mdx"}} (append .mdx to the result path).
registerTool def to expose it: {"name":"ask_mintlify","description":"Ask mintlify.com docs; returns cited passages.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"question":{"type":"string"}},"required":["question"]}} with execute running TIER 1.
TIER 2 — headed browser only (bot-gated chat): open https://www.mintlify.com/docs?assistant=<urlencoded question> (panel auto-opens; else click button[aria-label="Toggle assistant panel"]). Read [role="dialog"] text for the cited answer. Follow-ups: set textarea value, dispatch input, click Send — same tab keeps the thread. Needs a non-bot browser (webdriver=false alone is not enough).

proof.ref: askMintlify: multi-turn verified (?assistant= + panel read); declines out-of-scope (poem test); probe-mintlify: MCP initialize (Mintlify) + tools/list [search_mintlify, query_docs_filesystem_mintlify, submit_feedback] live; llms.txt 23900B; siteconfig present. Chat NOT verified (captcha-gated, needs non-bot browser).
